mapper.sql: q.quest_id, q.battle_id, q.guild_id, q.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, q.title, q.description, q.quest_type, q.target_value, q.current_value, q.unit, q.damage, q.reward_exp, q.reward_coin, q.status, q.source_type, CASE WHEN q.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_me, q.created_at, q.completed_at, q.rewarded_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quests q JOIN users u ON u.user_id = q.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = q.user_id WHERE q.battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE q.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 2 WHEN 'REWARDED' THEN 3 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, q.created_at ASC, q.quest_id ASC

SELECT q.quest_id, q.battle_id, q.guild_id, q.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, q.title, q.description, q.quest_type, q.target_value, q.current_value, q.unit, q.damage, q.reward_exp, q.reward_coin, q.status, q.source_type, TRUE AS is_me, q.created_at, q.completed_at, q.rewarded_at FROM quests q JOIN users u ON u.user_id = q.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = q.user_id WHERE q.battle_id = #{battleId} AND q.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM quests q JOIN users u ON u.user_id = q.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = q.user_id WHERE q.quest_id = #{questId}

SELECT quest_id, battle_id, guild_id, user_id, title, description, quest_type, target_value, current_value, unit, damage, reward_exp, reward_coin, status, source_type, created_at, completed_at, rewarded_at, updated_at FROM quests WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quests ( battle_id, guild_id, user_id, title, description, quest_type, target_value, current_value, unit, damage, reward_exp, reward_coin, status, source_type ) VALUES ( #{battleId}, #{guildId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{questType}, #{targetValue}, COALESCE(#{currentValue}, 0), #{unit}, COALESCE(#{damage}, 0), COALESCE(#{rewardExp}, 0), COALESCE(#{rewardCoin}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'IN_PROGRESS'), COALESCE(#{sourceType}, 'PLACEHOLDER') )
mapper.select: SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, bb.status, bb.max_hp, b.difficulty FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, gm.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY gm.joined_at ASC, gm.guild_member_id ASC

SELECT gm.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, COUNT(q.quest_id) AS total_quest_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_quest_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED') THEN q.damage ELSE 0 END) AS total_damage, COALESCE(SUM(q.damage), 0) AS expected_damage, CASE WHEN gm.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_me FROM boss_battles bb JOIN guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = bb.guild_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = gm.user_id LEFT JOIN quests q ON q.battle_id = bb.battle_id AND q.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY gm.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.name, c.level ORDER BY completed_quest_count DESC, total_damage DESC, gm.user_id ASC
